Single-arm DB bench press, neutral grip
Lat pulldown, neutral grip (stop at forehead)
Light landmine press to full lockout, single arm
Rotator cuff and scap activation series
Seated DB overhead press, neutral grip, back supported
Hangboard or bar hangs (passive then active)
Incline DB press (Arnold-style rotation if pain-free)
TRX or ring rows at decline

notes: Each upper session opens with a scap/cuff activation block
Phase 1: no overhead loading; all pressing below 90° shoulder flexion/abduction
Phase 1 Day 1 activation precedes A1 landmine press (no separate general warm-up specified beyond activation)
Phase 1 Day 2 activation: scapular pull-ups + band ER before main work
By Week 9 warm-up should take 8-10 min and client should know it cold
Phase 2: gradual loaded approach toward overhead via landmine/incline; no true vertical pressing yet
Phase 3: careful reintroduction of vertical pressing starting Week 9 with light seated DB OHP
Week 7 includes overhead reintroduction test with light landmine to full lockout
Stop and reassess on sharp subacromial pain, >24h lingering pain, lost ROM, or night pain
Climbing: off the wall in Phase 1; easy slab/vertical no dynamic/lock-offs in Phase 2; progressive return Phase 3; no campusing or heavy overhang until after Week 12 and physio recheck
Sleep: avoid sleeping on affected shoulder during Phase 1

raw_text:
# 12-Week Upper-Body Programme: Post-Impingement Climber

**Client Snapshot:** 29F, recreational climber, office worker (likely forward head/protracted scapulae from desk work), 4 months post right subacromial impingement diagnosis, cleared for pain-free ROM only, no overhead loading.

**Programme Goals:**
1. Restore scapular control and posterior chain capacity (the desk-job + climbing combo has almost certainly under-trained external rotators and lower traps)
2. Rebuild pressing and pulling strength without provoking the subacromial space
3. Progressively reintroduce overhead positions in the back half of the block
4. Return to climbing-relevant pulling capacity by week 12

**Programme Structure:** 3 upper-body sessions/week with 1 lower/core session inserted (typically Day 3) so we're not loading the shoulder four days running. Each upper session opens with a scap/cuff activation block.

---

## PHASE 1 — Foundation & Scapular Control (Weeks 1–4)

**Focus:** No overhead. Build scapular mechanics, rotator cuff endurance, and tolerance to horizontal pulling/pressing. All pressing stays below 90° of shoulder flexion/abduction. Pain-free ROM is the absolute ceiling — if she gets a pinch, we shorten the range.

**Weekly Template:**
- Day 1: Upper Push-Dominant (Horizontal)
- Day 2: Upper Pull-Dominant
- Day 3: Lower + Core
- Day 4: Upper Balanced / Postural

### Week 1 — Introduction & Baselining

**Day 1 — Push (Horizontal)**
- Activation: Band pull-aparts 2×15; Prone Y-T-W 2×8 each; Side-lying external rotation 2×12 (light, 1–2kg)
- A1. Landmine press (low angle, ~45°) 3×10 each side
- A2. Cable chest press, neutral grip, elbows ~60° from torso 3×12
- B1. Half-kneeling single-arm cable row 3×12
- B2. Dead bug 3×8/side
- Finisher: Carry — farmer's walk 3×30m moderate

**Day 2 — Pull**
- Activation: Scapular pull-ups (feet supported) 3×6; Band external rotation 2×15
- A1. Chest-supported row (machine or DB on incline bench) 4×10
- A2. Push-up (incline on bar, hands at hip height) 3×8 — focus on scap protraction at top
- B1. Straight-arm cable pulldown (range stops at shoulder height) 3×12
- B2. Face pull, cable at chest height 3×15
- Finisher: Hollow hold 3×20s

**Day 3 — Lower + Core**
- Goblet squat 3×10; RDL 3×10; Walking lunge 3×8/leg; Pallof press 3×10/side; Side plank 3×20s/side

**Day 4 — Postural / Balanced**
- Activation as Day 1
- A1. Trap-3 raise (prone on incline bench, thumb up, lift to ~90°) 3×10
- A2. Prone horizontal abduction 3×10
- B1. Seated cable row, wide grip, elbows flared (rear delt bias) 3×12
- B2. Floor press, neutral grip DB 3×10
- C1. Bicep curl 3×12
- C2. Triceps pushdown 3×12

### Week 2
Same exercise selection. Add load ~5% on main lifts where form is clean. Push-ups progress to slightly lower incline. Cuff work bumped to 2×15.

### Week 3
- Landmine press: 4×8 (heavier)
- Introduce **single-arm DB bench press, neutral grip** in place of cable chest press (3×10) — controlled, no lockout overshoot
- Chest-supported row: 4×8 heavier
- Add **prone trap raise (Y-raise to 120° max)** on Day 4 — first careful exposure toward overhead, bodyweight or 1kg

### Week 4 — Deload
All work sets at ~70% of Week 3 load, sets reduced by 1. Use this week to reassess: pain-free ROM in flexion, abduction, and external rotation. Should see improvement in scap upward rotation timing.

---

## PHASE 2 — Strength Reintroduction & Overhead Prep (Weeks 5–8)

**Focus:** Build strength in horizontal planes; gradually introduce loaded positions approaching overhead (landmine, incline) but no true vertical pressing yet. Begin tolerating climbing-specific pulling demands.

### Week 5

**Day 1 — Push**
- Activation: Add **wall slides** 2×10 (assess overhead reach quality) + band pull-aparts + cuff series
- A. DB bench press, neutral grip 4×8
- B. Landmine press, tall-kneeling, steeper angle (~60°) 4×8/side
- C1. Single-arm cable row 3×10
- C2. Push-up, hands on bench 3×10
- D. Triceps pushdown 3×12

**Day 2 — Pull**
- A. Lat pulldown, neutral grip, **stopping at forehead level (no full overhead start)** 4×8
- B. Chest-supported T-bar or DB row 4×8
- C1. Face pull 3×15
- C2. Inverted row (rings or bar) 3×8
- D. Hammer curl 3×10

**Day 4 — Postural / Hypertrophy**
- A. Incline DB press, ~30° bench, neutral grip 4×8
- B. Seated cable row 4×10
- C. Rear delt fly 3×12
- D1. Lateral raise (to 80° only, scaption plane) 3×12
- D2. Trap-3 raise 3×10

### Week 6
- Progress lat pulldown to **slightly past forehead start position** if pain-free
- Introduce **half-kneeling landmine press to near-vertical** (~75°) 4×6
- DB bench 4×6 heavier
- Add **pull-up negatives** (3s descent) 3×4 on Day 2

### Week 7
- **Pull-up assessment:** if scap control is good, assisted pull-ups (machine or band) 4×5
- **Overhead reintroduction test:** light landmine press to full lockout, single arm — if pain-free, keep; if not, hold at Week 6 angle
- Climbing-specific: **scapular pull-ups from a bar** 3×8 + **typewriter hangs** (passive) 3×20s
- Maintain DB bench, rows, postural work

### Week 8 — Deload
70% loads, drop a set per exercise. Reassess overhead ROM — by now we should be aiming for pain-free full flexion with light load.

---

## PHASE 3 — Overhead Reintroduction & Climbing Integration (Weeks 9–12)

**Focus:** Carefully reintroduce vertical pressing. Build pulling strength toward climbing demands. Maintain all the postural/cuff work — this stuff stays in the programme forever, basically.

### Week 9

**Day 1 — Push (now with overhead)**
- Activation: full cuff and scap series (her warm-up should now take 8–10 min and she should know it cold)
- A. **Seated DB overhead press, neutral grip, back supported** 4×6 — start LIGHT (think half of what she'd guess). This is the first true overhead load in months.
- B. DB bench press 4×6
- C1. Single-arm row 3×10
- C2. Push-up 3×12
- D. Triceps + cuff finisher

**Day 2 — Pull (climbing bias)**
- A. **Pull-ups** — assisted or bodyweight depending on Week 7 assessment, 4×5
- B. Pendlay row or barbell row 4×6
- C. Lat pulldown 3×10
- D. **Hangboard or bar hangs** — passive then active, 4×15–20s
- E. Grip work: plate pinches or farmer's hold 3×30s

**Day 4 — Postural maintenance + Hypertrophy**
- Incline DB press, Arnold-style rotation if pain-free 4×8
- Chest-supported row 4×10
- Lateral raise (full ROM if pain-free) 3×12
- Rear delt fly 3×15
- Curls + tri superset 3×12

### Week 10
- Overhead press 4×5 heavier
- Pull-ups: aim for 3–5 bodyweight reps in first set
- Introduce **single-arm DB overhead press** 3×6/side
- Add **TRX or ring rows at decline** 3×8 (climbing lock-off bias)

### Week 11 — Peak Week
- Overhead press 5×3 at top weight she can manage with clean technique
- Pull-ups 4×AMRAP (cap at 8)
- Weighted hangs if appropriate, 4×10s
- Bench, rows, postural work all at peak loads

### Week 12 — Deload + Reassessment
- All loads 60–70%, volume cut
- End-of-block assessment: pain-free overhead ROM, pull-up max, single-arm OHP load, shoulder symmetry, return-to-climbing readiness
- Plan next block based on findings (likely climbing-specific power/endurance work)

---

## Recovery & Lifestyle Notes

**Daily (give her these as homework):**
- Doorway pec stretch 2×30s/side
- Thoracic extension over foam roller 2×8 reps
- Chin tucks 2×10 (desk-worker non-negotiable)
- Band external rotation 1×15/side as a "snack" during work breaks

**Sleep position:** avoid sleeping on the affected shoulder for at least Phase 1. A pillow under the arm if side-lying on the left helps.

**Workstation:** screen at eye level, elbows supported. The single biggest thing outside the gym for her impingement is reducing 8 hours/day of protraction.

**Climbing return:** I'd keep her off the wall (or strictly easy traversing, no overhead reaching) through Phase 1. Phase 2 she can do easy slab/vertical with no dynamic moves or full lock-offs. Phase 3 she can progressively return to her normal grade, but no campusing or heavy overhang until well after Week 12 and a physio re-check.

## Red Flags — Stop and Reassess
- Sharp pain (not muscular fatigue) in the subacromial region
- Pain that lingers >24h post-session
- Loss of pain-free ROM week-to-week
- Night pain returning

If any of these appear, pull back a phase and get the physio back in the loop. Better to add a fourth week to a phase than push her back into a flare.

Want me to write up the lower/core day in more detail, or build a specific climbing-return protocol for weeks 10–12?
